statements.__comment: Global orphan sweep, deliberately tenant-independent: tenant cleanups delete only their own edges to EC2Image (a legacy node can still be linked from several tenants), and the node goes once no edge refers to it. Only nodes no sync has written for 24h (86400s; lastupdated is a sync start time, reused across a paginated run) are swept, so a node another worker has just written and not yet linked survives.
statements.query: MATCH (n:EC2Image) WHERE NOT EXISTS { (n)--() } AND coalesce(n.lastupdated, 0) < $UPDATE_TAG - 86400 WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (n) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
